articles.summary: (Hong Kong, March 4, 2026) The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) received a generous donation of HKD 30 million from Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (Futu) to support the University’s innovation and research development, as well as to establish a new scholarship recognizing outstanding HKUST students. In appreciation of Futu’s dedicated support, the University has named a multi-purpose learning facility at the Lee Shau Kee Library as the “Futu Academic Pavilion,” which serving as a key academic center for its faculty and students to engage in teaching, group discussions, and individual learning. This initiative not only underscores the importance of industry-academia collaboration in talent development but also lays a solid foundation for long-term cooperation between the two parties.
articles.title: HKUST Hosts Naming Ceremony of Futu Academic Pavilion

articles.summary: (Hong Kong, January 21, 2026) Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited ("Futu") released its "2026 Hong Kong Retail Investor Report". Based on a survey of over 2,000 clients and platform data, the report analyzes the behaviors of Hong Kong investors during the interest rate downward cycle. Findings show that nearly 80% of Futu’s clients in Hong Kong achieved positive returns in 2025, with an average annual return of 23.2%[1], highlighting how investors seized allocation opportunities amid market volatility.
articles.title: Futu Releases 2026 Hong Kong Retail Investor Report: Nearly 80% of Clients Achieved Positive Returns in 2025 Hong Kong investors shift from defensive to aggressive strategies as the rate-cut cycle accelerates capital reallocation

articles.summary: (Hong Kong, March 26, 2026) — Futu Holdings Limited ("Futu" or the "Group") (Nasdaq: FUTU) has reached a significant new milestone: its wholly-owned, self-built virtual asset trading platform (VATP), PantherTrade (Hong Kong) Limited (“PantherTrade”), has announced the commencement of full-scale licensed operations. PantherTrade is poised for imminent integration with Futu Securities, the Group’s retail brokerage platform in Hong Kong, providing essential infrastructure support such as virtual asset trade matching, asset custody, and technical solutions. Through this deep integration between PantherTrade and Futu Securities, the Group is set to launch synergistic dual-track operations for traditional finance and Web3 within a fully compliant regulatory framework.

articles.summary: Today, Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited ("Futu"), a leading tech broker in Hong Kong, held its annual investment strategy sharing session. At the event, Arnold Tam, Chief Analyst at Futu Securities, Joe Yu, Executive Director of Institutional and Private Wealth Services at Futu Securities, and Daniel Tse, Managing Director at Futu Securities, shared forward-looking insights and investment strategies across multiple market hot topics. They anticipate increased market volatility next year, alongside a shift from this year’s “single-theme strategy” toward a more “multi-polar strategy”. Investors are advised to remain flexible and diversify across asset classes and income streams to mitigate risk effectively and capture a broader range of emerging opportunities.
articles.title: Futu 2026 Market Outlook: Flexible and Diversified Investment Strategies for a New Global Economic Normal
